title: Beef Tips & Gravy over Mashed Potatoes
description: Tender beef tips simmered in savory gravy and served over mashed potatoes.

ingredients.item: beef stew meat or sirloin tips

steps.text: Brown the beef in oil in a large skillet; work in batches so it browns instead of steams.
Add onion and cook until softened. Stir in flour, then slowly stir in beef broth.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender and the gravy thickens, about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile boil potatoes until fork-tender, about 15 minutes; drain and mash with milk and butter. Serve beef and gravy over potatoes.

title: Homestyle Beef Stroganoff
description: Beef and mushrooms in a creamy savory sauce over egg noodles.

steps.text: Cook egg noodles according to package directions; drain.
Melt butter in a large skillet. Brown beef quickly in batches and set aside. Cook onion and mushrooms until tender.
Stir flour into the vegetables, then slowly add beef broth. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Return beef to the skillet and cook until hot and safely done. Remove from heat, stir in sour cream, and serve over noodles.

title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes
description: Browned steak bites and crisp-tender potatoes finished with garlic butter.

steps.text: Microwave or parboil the potatoes for 6–8 minutes until just beginning to soften; drain well.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and cook potatoes until browned and tender, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add steak bites in a single layer and brown, turning until cooked to the household's preferred safe doneness.
Lower heat, add butter and garlic, then return potatoes to the skillet and toss everything together for 1–2 minutes.

title: Sheet-Pan Steak Fajitas
description: Colorful steak fajitas roasted together on one sheet pan.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Spread steak, peppers, and onion on a sheet pan.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with fajita seasoning, and toss well.
Roast 15–20 minutes, stirring once, until vegetables are tender and steak is safely cooked.
Squeeze lime over the pan and serve in warm tortillas.

title: Beef & Broccoli with Rice
description: A family-friendly beef and broccoli stir-fry with a simple savory sauce.

steps.text: Cook rice in water according to package directions.
Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, and 1/2 cup water until smooth.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Brown beef in batches, then set aside. Add broccoli and a splash of water; cover 3–4 minutes.
Return beef, add garlic and sauce, and simmer until thickened and beef is safely cooked. Serve over rice.

title: Classic Cottage Pie
description: Seasoned ground beef and vegetables under a golden blanket of mashed potatoes.

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Boil potatoes until tender, then mash with milk and butter.
Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet; drain excess fat. Stir in tomato paste, vegetables, and beef broth.
Simmer 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened, then spread in a baking dish.
Spoon mashed potatoes over the beef mixture and bake 25 minutes until hot and lightly browned.

title: Oven-Baked BBQ Chicken & Potatoes
description: Juicy barbecue chicken with seasoned roasted potatoes for an easy family supper.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with olive oil, garlic powder, and salt on a sheet pan.
Arrange chicken thighs among the potatoes and roast 25 minutes.
Brush chicken generously with barbecue sauce, stir potatoes, and return to the oven.
Roast 15–20 minutes more until chicken reaches 165°F in the thickest part and potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Parmesan with Spaghetti
description: Crispy breaded chicken with marinara and melted cheese served with spaghetti.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin cutlets

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Dip chicken in beaten egg, then coat with breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Place on an oiled sheet pan, drizzle lightly with oil, and bake 15 minutes; turn once.
Top chicken with marinara and mozzarella and bake 8–10 minutes more, until chicken reaches 165°F and cheese melts.
Meanwhile cook spaghetti according to package directions. Serve chicken with spaghetti and remaining warm marinara.

title: Chicken-Fried Chicken with Country Gravy
description: Crispy skillet chicken cutlets with creamy peppered country gravy.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin cutlets

steps.text: Whisk egg with 1 cup milk. Season chicken, dip in egg mixture, then coat in 1 cup flour.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry chicken in batches until golden and the center reaches 165°F; drain on a rack or paper towels.
Carefully pour off most oil, leaving about 3 tablespoons. Whisk in remaining 1/2 cup flour and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in 2 cups milk and black pepper. Simmer until thickened, then serve gravy over chicken.

title: Fish Tacos with Slaw & Lime Crema

Fill warm tortillas with fish and slaw. Drizzle with remaining lime crema and serve with lime wedges.
